power.supply: Internal 290 W (Bronze), 100 to 240 VAC 50/60 Hz autoranging

notes: Channels are licensed per camera; the sheet states no per-device channel maximum.
Power consumption is given only as heat dissipation: 989 BTU/hr maximum, which the sheet calculates from the 290 W power supply rating.
The v3.0 sheet lists 4 x Mini DisplayPort 1.4 in a cell shared across the server columns, while its per-output resolution table and the v1.2 sheet give DisplayPort and DVI for this server.
The v3.0 sheet gives an operating range of 10° to 50°C (32° to 95°F); the v1.2 sheet gives 10° to 35°C (50° to 95°F).
USB port counts differ between the v1.2 and v3.0 sheets, so no USB count is given.
